ticket.title: Preview a remote flight document
ticket.description: Signed-in staff can enter a document URL and see a text preview. The preview service runs inside the Spaceways network, which can reach internal services that public browsers cannot.
requirements: Accept a document URL from a signed-in staff member.
Return a text preview of the document.
Do not expose internal-only services through the preview feature.

pr.title: Add remote document preview
pr.description: Fetches the supplied URL on the server and returns the response body as a preview.
pr.author: starlight-dev

aiReview.summary: Consider what network locations the preview server can reach compared with a staff member's browser, then trace where the supplied URL is fetched.

findings.title: Inspect the preview fetch destination
findings.detail: Check which destinations the supplied URL can resolve to and whether the request can be redirected elsewhere.

proposedAnswer.reason: The server's network access gives the supplied URL more reach than the staff member may have directly.
